This exam is calmer, but it asks about the same geometry that made all that possible.

A procedural exam with exercises from the whole block — computations of coordinates and distances, matrices, noise, cameras, light — timed and with no hints, to find out whether the geometry behind each shader has sunk in.
Un examen de bloque es un simulacro hech: A block exam is a mock done at home: with a clock, no notes and no hints. The questions come from the exercises of the block's 33 topics, spread across sections, and each time you start one the numbers are different and so are the topics: doing it several times covers the whole block. On submitting, everything is marked, the step-by-step solution to each question opens and the mark comes out by section, with links to what is worth revising. The “tailored to what you have done” option puts first what you have not yet solved: it is the way to check that no topic is left untouched.
